about: V3 4.1 exit check: 10 hand-written fault questions, phrased the way I'd ask them mid-incident (not copied from the docs). A question HITS when any of its `expect` substrings occurs in one of the top-5 hits' path, id or title (Q9 was tightened from any 'selfcheck:' hit to the baseline/run-note sections after the first run showed a re-mint addendum at #1). Written 2026-11-04 BEFORE the ranking was tuned. Q1-Q4 expect the fault_inject sandbox bundles (they only exist after `diag_corpus.py build --sandbox-glob ...` has seen a `fault_inject.py run all --keep`).

questions.q: the ears came up but transcription is dead, whisper never warmed and smart-turn says degraded
a GPU job got deferred and the gpu probe is yellow, VRAM is almost full
events stopped being recorded and writes under state fail with no space left on device
voice_listen returns ok false immediately, the network mic connection is refused
the server's disk died, how do I bring iris back from the tower backup
ears went red twice in ten minutes but only one incident bundle was written, why no second one
which test proves a model load is refused when free VRAM is under the need plus reserve
a worker task ran even though the task it depends on had failed
what were the runtime liveness numbers last self-check, is the process count normal
someone on a call is using a cloned copy of my voice, what's the defense
